headline: Novo Nordisk Reports Positive Phase 3 Wegovy Results for MASH Liver Disease
summary: Novo Nordisk published positive data showing semaglutide 2.4 mg (Wegovy) effectively treats the fatty liver condition metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH).
why: Novo Nordisk is a leading multinational healthcare company specializing in diabetes and obesity therapies.

impacts.name: Novo Nordisk A/S
impacts.why: Positive clinical trial data expands the potential market applications for Wegovy.
